title: Rav Shmuel bar Papa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites Yoma 36a for the passage that mentions him explaining a teaching before Rav Ada. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Shmuel bar Acha explaining it before Rav Papa. Hyman endorses that reading: Rav Shmuel bar Papa is not found in the Talmud, whereas Rav Shmuel bar Acha is always found with Rav Papa.

notes.text: The absence of Shmuel bar Papa and the assertion that Shmuel bar Acha is always found with Rav Papa are Hyman’s judgments, not a new search of the Talmud. The supplied locator has a period after Yoma 36, rendered 36a.
The consulted text at Yoma 37a names Rav Shmuel bar Papa explaining the teaching before Rav Ada. The notice cites 36a and prefers the different names reported in Dikdukei Soferim.
